Plot cell-type probability histograms

Source: R/visualisation.R
plot_score_hist.Rd

Faceted histograms of per-cell probabilities for each cell type, using the probability columns already stored in `colData(spe)` (e.g., `P_T_cell`, `P_Tumor`).

Usage

plot_score_hist(
  res,
  prob_prefix = "P_",
  binwidth = 0.01,
  drop_na = TRUE,
  cutoff_fn = prob_quantile_cutoff,
  label_col = NULL,
  label_levels = NULL,
  label_colors = NULL,
  drop_levels = FALSE
)

Arguments

res

Result list containing an `spe` element with probability columns.

prob_prefix

Prefix used for probability columns in `colData(spe)`. Default "P_".

binwidth

Histogram bin width. Default 0.01.

drop_na

Logical; drop NA probabilities before plotting. Default TRUE.

cutoff_fn

Function taking a numeric vector of probabilities for a cell type and returning a single numeric cutoff to draw. Default [prob_quantile_cutoff()], which uses the 0.98 quantile.

label_col

Optional column in `colData(spe)` used to color histograms by ground truth (or any label column).

label_levels

Optional character vector of label levels to enforce for legend consistency.

label_colors

Optional named or unnamed vector of colors to use for the label levels. If provided alongside `label_levels`, lengths must match.

drop_levels

Logical; if FALSE, keep unused levels in the legend. Default FALSE.

Value

A `ggplot` object with faceted histograms.

Examples

data("cytoGateR_example", package = "cytoGateR")
spe <- cytoGateR_example
plot_score_hist(list(spe = spe), binwidth = 0.1)
